title: Capitalize INF, -INF, and NAN in serializing
key_points: The editor inspector cannot display non-finite values such as infinity and NaN.
If the check for non-finite values is removed, they become allowed.
Non-finite values have to be typed as 'INF', '-INF', or 'NAN' like GDScript.
Removing the check for negative sign rearranges the code slightly.
limitations: The change requires fixing reading negated identifiers such as -inf and INF.
Capitalizing the displayed and serialized text is an arbitrary choice made by engine developers.
asserts: Allowing users to type both 'inf' and 'INF' alongside capitalizing the displayed and serialized text improves consistency in displaying non-finite values.
scope: The source asserts about improving user experience and consistency in displaying non-finite values such as infinity and NaN in Godot's editor inspector.
